philippines.title: AI, online tracker boost public scrutiny of national budget
philippines.description:
MANILA — Artificial intelligence (AI) and citizen-developed digital tools are speeding up the Senate’s scrutiny of the proposed PHP7.2-trillion national budget, giving Filipinos an online platform to track congressional project insertions and changes in funding allocations. During the Senate Committee on Finance hearing on Monday, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said civil society organizations (CSOs) produced an analysis of the House-approved 2027 budget within a day using AI and computer coding. He noted that similar assessments previously took one to two weeks, giving senators less time to examine questionable allocations before deliberations. energy.title: Russian Refiners Ramp Up Diesel Output to Supply Trump Deal
energy.description: Russian refiners have raised diesel output for October after Moscow issued export quotas under the Kremlin’s supply agreement with the United States, two industry sources told Reuters on Monday. Daily production fell to about 160,000 metric tons in the first half of the month, from 175,000 tons in September. It began climbing toward 180,000 tons a day once the quotas arrived in mid-October. Russia’s domestic diesel consumption typically drops to about 140,000 tons a day in October, after the grain harvest and the summer driving season…

energy.title: Is Wall Street Getting It All Wrong About AI, Oil, and Bonds?
energy.description: It seems that everywhere you look in the financial media these days, there is persistent hype about artificial intelligence (AI) and the companies developing it.
